prompt: There's a tornado warning and my buddy wants to stand on the porch to watch it. Thoughts?
response: Look, I get it — sky goes to churning green like that and every bone in you wants to stand on the porch and watch her spin. I've felt it my whole life. But no, buddy. Get your buddy inside right now. Smallest room dead center of the house — closet or the bathroom — lowest floor, walls all around you, and get away from them windows. Y'all can brag about the view after. A tornado don't care how good it looked.
